 As cold air gradually moves south and chilly winds blow, today (October 21) will remain chilly throughout the day. 
 Starting at 14.2°C (58°F) this morning, Seoul's temperature will struggle to rise during the day, peaking at just 16°C (61°F)—about 7°C lower than yesterday afternoon. 
 Tomorrow morning, the temperature in Seoul is expected to plummet to 5°C (41°F), marking the coolest morning of this autumn. 
 Along with the southern coast and Jeju Island, where rain is currently falling, light rain of less than 5 mm is expected in the central regions and Jeonbuk until this morning. 
 Strong winds will also blow nationwide today. 
 Starting with a current temperature of 14.2°C (58°F) in Daejeon, the daytime high will hover around 18°C (64°F). 
 (Weather forecaster Park Se-rim)
